introduction: Many people think of the One World Trade Center as the tallest building in New York City and in the
lead_intro: Think you know which is the tallest building in New York City? Let's test your knowledge with this quiz!

quiz.question: Which building in New York City is generally regarded as the tallest?
quiz.explanation: One World Trade Center is generally regarded as the tallest building in New York City.

quiz.question: What makes up much of the height of One World Trade Center?
quiz.explanation: Much of the height of One World Trade Center is made up of its large spire.

quiz.question: Which building is taller than One World Trade Center when measured by roof height?
quiz.explanation: The Central Park Tower is taller than One World Trade Center when measured by roof height.

quiz.question: In what year did the Central Park Tower open?
quiz.explanation: The Central Park Tower opened in 2021.

quiz.question: How can different buildings contest the title of the tallest in New York City?
quiz.explanation: Different buildings can contest the title of the tallest by being taller when measured by roof height.
